visual_goal.description: Compact wooden box mill with chrome dome top and lateral hand crank; stylized proportions emphasize the overhanging plates, bright steel dome, and large wooden knob.
signature_features: Square wooden box with rounded base and overhanging top plate
Polished metal low dome with circular flange
Vertical spindle with crank arm and spherical wooden knob on the right side
Front pull-out drawer with round metal pull
Small front badge plate above the drawer
Exposed screws on the top plate and around the dome
